exams.name: Commission examination

definition_quote.value: A person is practicing medicine if he or she does one or more of the following: (1) Offers or undertakes to diagnose, cure, advise, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means or instrumentality; (2) Administers or prescribes drugs or medicinal preparations to be used by any other person; (3) Severs or penetrates the tissues of human beings; (4) Uses on cards, books, papers, signs, or other written or printed means of giving information to the public, in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the diagnosis or treatment of human disease or conditions the designation "doctor of medicine," "physician," "surgeon," "m.d.," or any combination thereof
definition_quote.quote: A person is practicing medicine if he or she does one or more of the following: (1) Offers or undertakes to diagnose, cure, advise, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means or instrumentality; (2) Administers or prescribes drugs or medicinal preparations to be used by any other person; (3) Severs or penetrates the tissues of human beings

methods_authorized.quote: Offers or undertakes to diagnose, cure, advise, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means or instrumentality

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must complete equivalent medical education, pass the ECFMG examination (or equivalent approved by commission rules), demonstrate English language proficiency, and complete two years of postgraduate medical training acceptable to the commission. Waivers of certain requirements may be granted for exceptional qualifications or hardship scenarios.

pain_management_education_required.quote: By January 1, 2019, the commission must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: The commission must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs, potentially including dosing criteria, consultation requirements, and guidance on tracking opioid use. Rules may contain exemptions based on education, training, amount of opioids prescribed, patient panel, and practice environment. Rules do not apply to palliative/hospice/end-of-life care or management of acute pain from injury or surgery.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: By January 1, 2019, the commission must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs. The rules may contain exemptions based on education, training, amount of opioids prescribed, patient panel, and practice environment.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Out-of-state practitioners may consult through telemedicine with a Washington-licensed practitioner who has responsibility for diagnosis and treatment, without needing a Washington license. The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact affirms that practice of medicine occurs where the patient is located.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The consultation through telemedicine or other means by a practitioner, licensed by another state or territory in which he or she resides, with a practitioner licensed in this state who has responsibility for the diagnosis and treatment of the patient within this state

telemedicine_license_available.quote: the member states of the interstate medical licensure compact have allied in common purpose to develop a comprehensive process that complements the existing licensing and regulatory authority of state medical boards, provides a streamlined process that allows physicians to become licensed in multiple states

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: the member states of the interstate medical licensure compact have allied in common purpose to develop a comprehensive process that complements the existing licensing and regulatory authority of state medical boards

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: The practice of medicine by a licensed physician assistant which practice is performed under the supervision of or in collaboration with a physician licensed pursuant to this chapter

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A supervising physician may supervise no more than four license holders under this subsection unless the commission grants a request to increase this limit.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Every institution or organization providing professional liability insurance to physicians shall send a complete report to the commission of all malpractice settlements, awards, or payments in excess of twenty thousand dollars as a result of a claim or action for damages alleged to have been caused by an insured physician's incompetency or negligence in the practice of medicine.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Every license holder, corporation, organization, health care facility, and state and local governmental agency that employs a license holder shall report to the disciplining authority when the employed license holder's services have been terminated or restricted based upon a final determination that the license holder has either committed an act or acts that may constitute unprofessional conduct

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The commission shall enter into a contract with the entity to implement a physician health program.
